title: Actual coefficient transport of positive Chern adjuncts
statement: For a completed trace presentation p as in [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation], CompletedChernNormalized(p,a) is the equation that restriction of a followed by p.sourceMap equals the unit-limit comparison followed by Rlim(systemChern). For a Reference r for a Family [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference], transport a normalized completed Chern adjunct first through r.eS and its unit and shifted-line comparisons, then the prescribed realization/direct-image square. Transport it successively through the actual scalar mates and unit/line endpoint isomorphisms of Family [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams]. Define scalarQChern and scalarP2Chern by doing this separately for r.tq and r.t2. At a finite coefficient use Z_l -> O_E -> E; at the closure use the bottom finite subfield and its Family.toClosure map. Finish with the recorded canonical right-derived pushforward identification. Define scalarTwistedUnit as the derived adjunction unit followed by pushforward of the root-normalized shifted-line comparison. Define scalarQLineIso by the prescribed q comparison, and scalarUnitPullIso by pullback of singleUnitIso, secondTraceUnitIso and inverse singleUnitIso. These are explicit composites; no Chern arrow is chosen in a definition.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K.

proof.text: Construct the realized arrow by inverse unit comparison, realization of the input arrow, normalized direct-image comparison, and image of the shifted-line comparison. Construct scalar extension by the identical four-arrow recipe using the actual scalar/direct-image mate. Apply the recipes to q and p2 independently and to the selected coefficient path. Construct the twisted-unit and the two endpoint comparisons from the existing adjunction and root-normalized maps.

def scalarQChern (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    {δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y}
    {family : Family l Y} (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) :
    unit (coefficient l c).X Y ⟶
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y))
          0).obj (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
